Latte-news-fetcher 1.0.0

- Major simplification and streamlining of the skill.
- Removed advanced techniques, paywall bypass, and in-depth browser automation strategies.
- Focused on free news sources, RSS subscription, and Tavily search for alternatives.
- Reworked output to prioritize concise Markdown news digests.
- Reduced external references and configuration complexity.
